<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog using the forward‑reaction criteria described for the Peterson reaction: it forms a C‑C double bond and breaks a ketone and a trimethylsilyl group. I’ll query with the target SMILES and these functional‑group constraints.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "trimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
